_comment: Hand-authored, realism-guarded business intents keyed by manifest path. Each value is a list of product-ask phrasings that do NOT restate manifest fields (no 'type: remote', 'framework: react', capability names, or lifecycle). The generator (generate.mjs) pairs each intent with the manifest file's verbatim text as the completion. These are the high-realism core; the synthetic tail is generated. Style note: a few intents carry a light framework/context hint (e.g. 'the Angular ops team') on purpose, so the model can learn to condition when a signal is present and default otherwise.
examples/abc-kids/animal-sounds/mfe-mani: Little kids should hear an animal noise and tap the animal that made it — a quick, playful guessing round with a friendly cover tile so it shows up on the ABC Kids launcher.
We want an audio-matching mini-game for toddlers: play a sound, they pick the right critter. It needs a title/cover card and the little blurb the home grid reads to list it.
Add an 'animal sounds' game to the kids fleet — one playable round, a cover screen, and enough metadata for the launcher to show its name and age range.
examples/abc-kids/color-mixer/mfe-manife: A kids' game where children mix two paints to hit a target color — playable round, a cover card for the launcher, and the usual game-info blurb.
Product wants a color-mixing activity for preschoolers: combine two swatches to match a goal color. Ship it as its own tile on the ABC Kids home screen.
Give me a paint-mixing mini-game — the play experience plus a cover and metadata so it slots into the kids launcher grid.
examples/abc-kids/counting-stars/mfe-man: Toddlers tap exactly the right number of stars to match a number — a simple counting game with a cover tile and launcher metadata.
We need an early-numeracy game: show a number, kids tap that many stars. Needs the playable round, a cover card, and a blurb for the home grid.
Add a counting game to the kids fleet where you tap the correct quantity of stars; include the cover and game-info bits the launcher needs.

Give me an arcade flapping game with score-keeping backed by a lightweight API, plus the cover and metadata for the ABC Kids home grid.
